quizData.question:
What will be printed by the following mixed arithmetic expression?

```java
System.out.println(25 / 2 * 2.0);
```

What will be printed by the following floating-point expression?

```java
System.out.println(25.0 / 2 * 2);
```

Evaluate the following code utilizing the Math class. What is the output?

```java
System.out.print(Math.max(12, 23.0));
```
